unit: P101 U06 Momentum, work and energy balances
standard: Teaching standard v1.11; fixed illustrated M101 v0.4; construction policy v1.0
authority: User requested local sequential lesson development/review, complete closing resources, whole-unit review, and publication when required checks pass.
process: Introduction and five lessons developed and subject/reader/visual reviewed sequentially. Whole-unit coherence reviewed after closing resources. Reviews are distinct passes by the author, not independent human peer review.
coherence: Signed momentum and an explicit system/interval precede internal cancellation and approximate conservation. Common final velocity supplies the missing condition for sticking; momentum does not imply kinetic-energy conservation.

Constant-force work and its sign lead to the kinetic-energy theorem, then Earth-object potential energy and a positive dissipated-energy ledger. Gravity is counted once. Negative potential energy is distinguished from impossible negative kinetic energy.

Final method selection returns to the opening trolley problem and combines collision and climbing in separate intervals. Questions vary retrieval, diagnosis, dependent normal/friction calculation, mixed balances and code critique.
Unit conclusion prepares thermal transfer in U07 without introducing its teaching. No calculus work integrals, continuous impulse integration, restitution or rotational dynamics are assumed.

The 18-hour allocation includes introductions, all practice and feedback, two60-minute Python activities, and closing reference revision. Closing lesson35 reading+100 written+45 feedback minutes; exercise attempts90minutes within that total.
